authenticity_review: High photorealism overall with excellent fur/wool texture rendering and natural lighting. However, two minor artifacts reduce authenticity: (1) slight fusion between flanks of central two rabbits creates ambiguous boundary (severity 2), and (2) sheep's front right leg shows texture smoothing anomaly compared to other legs (severity 1). These defects are localized and do not compromise overall scene coherence, but prevent a perfect score.
key_defects: Slight body fusion between second and third rabbits from left (boundary ambiguity)
Minor texture smoothing on sheep's front right leg
